relationships.subject: Mrgprd neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Among DRG subpopulations, Grik1 expression is most prominent in the Mrgprd and Th neuronal subtypes, where it is detected in 93.2% of approximately 2,600 Mrgprd neurons

relationships.subject: satellite glia
relationships.evidence_quote: Grik2 is highly prevalent in satellite glia (88.54% of cells) and non-myelinating Schwann cells (90.22%)

relationships.subject: kainate receptors
relationships.evidence_quote: These data suggest that GluK4 is the preferred high-affinity subunit for the assembly of heteromeric KARs in sensory neurons, serving as a central hub in KAR assembly within DRG populations.

key_findings: Harmonized DRG atlas shows Grik1/Grik4 enriched in Mrgprd, Th and pruriceptor populations, while Grik2/Grik5 are enriched in Mrgprd, Pvalb and Trpm8 neurons.
Grik2 is highly expressed in satellite glia and non-myelinating Schwann cells, an unexplored area for pain.
